Feature: Admin functionality for managing Specialities and Doctors
  Background: Admin is logged in and has access to the management features
    In order to effectively manage the healthcare facility
    As an Admin with the ability to add, update, and delete Specialities and Doctors
    I want to ensure that I can perform all required actions without errors

  Scenario: Admin adds a new unique Speciality
    Given a new Speciality type is available for addition
    When the Admin adds the new Speciality with a unique name
    Then the system should confirm the addition and display the Speciality details

  Scenario: Admin updates the details of an existing Speciality
    Given an existing Speciality with specific details is already in the system
    When the Admin updates the name and description of the Speciality
    Then the system should reflect the updated details and confirm the changes

  Scenario: Admin deletes a Speciality
    Given a Speciality with no associated Doctors is selected for deletion
    When the Admin confirms the deletion
    Then the Speciality should be removed and a confirmation message should be displayed

  Scenario: Admin maintains Doctors associated with a Speciality
    Given a Speciality exists with associated Doctors
    When the Admin reassigns a Doctor to a different Speciality
    Then the Doctor should appear under the new Speciality

  Scenario: Admin adds a new Doctor to a Speciality
    Given a Speciality exists and a Doctor is not yet associated with it
    When the Admin adds a new Doctor to the Speciality
    Then the Doctor should be listed under the Speciality

  Scenario: Admin updates a Doctor' extrinsic information
    Given a Doctor with specific details is already in the system
    When the Admin updates the contact information or specialization of the Doctor
    Then the Doctor's details should reflect the updates and confirm the changes

  Scenario: Admin deletes a Doctor from a Speciality
    Given a Doctor with specific details is associated with a Speciality
    When the Admin confirms the deletion of the Doctor
    Then the Doctor should be removed and a confirmation message should be displayed

  Scenario: Admin ensures no Doctor is left without a Speciality
    Given multiple Specialities and Doctors are present
    When the Admin reassigns all Doctors to a new Speciality
    Then all Doctors should be associated with the new Speciality

Scenario Outline: Admin handles unique Speciality addition
  Background: Admin is logged in and has access to the management features
    In order to effectively manage the healthcare facility
    As an Admin with the ability to add, update, and delete Specialities and Doctors
    I want to ensure that I can perform all required actions without errors

  Scenario: Admin adds a new unique Speciality with normal values
    Given a new Speciality type is available for addition
    When the Admin adds the new Speciality with a unique name "<name>"
    Then the system should confirm the addition and display the Speciality details

  Scenario Outline: Admin updates an existing Speciality with normal values
    Given an existing Speciality with specific details is already in the system
    When the Admin updates the name and description of the Speciality
    Then the system should reflect the updated details and confirm the changes

  Scenario Outline: Admin deletes a Speciality with no associated Doctors
    Given a Speciality with no associated Doctors is selected for deletion
    When the Admin confirms the deletion
    Then the Speciality should be removed and a confirmation message should be displayed

  Scenario Outline: Admin maintains Doctors associated with a Speciality
    Given a Speciality exists with associated Doctors
    When the Admin reassigns a Doctor to a different Speciality
    Then the Doctor should appear under the new Speciality

  Scenario Outline: Admin adds a new Doctor to a Speciality with normal values
    Given a Speciality exists and a Doctor is not yet associated with it
    When the Admin adds a new Doctor to the Speciality
    Then the Doctor should be listed under the Speciality

  Scenario Outline: Admin updates a Doctor' extrinsic information
    Given a Doctor with specific details is already in the system
    When the Admin updates the contact information or specialization of the Doctor
    Then the Doctor's details should reflect the updates and confirm the changes

  Scenario Outline: Admin deletes a Doctor from a Speciality with normal values
    Given a Doctor with specific details is associated with a Speciality
    When the Admin confirms the deletion of the Doctor
    Then the Doctor should be removed and a confirmation message should be displayed

  Scenario Outline: Admin ensures no Doctor is left without a Speciality
    Given multiple Specialities and Doctors are present
    When the Admin reassigns all Doctors to a new Speciality
    Then all Doctors should be associated with the new Speciality

  Scenario: Admin handles unique Speciality addition with edge values
    Given a Speciality type that is nearly identical to existing ones is available for addition
    When the Admin adds the new Speciality with a unique name that is close to existing ones
    Then the system should prompt for clarification and prevent duplicate entries

  Scenario: Admin handles unique Speciality addition with invalid values
    Given a Speciality type that is not allowed (e.g., numeric or empty string) is available for addition
    When the Admin attempts to add a Speciality with an invalid name
    Then the system should reject the entry and prompt for a valid name

  Scenario: Admin handles unique Speciality addition with boundary values
    Given a Speciality type that is at the boundary of allowed naming conventions is available for addition
    When the Admin adds a Speciality with a name at the boundary of allowed naming conventions
    Then the system should accept the entry but may require additional confirmation

  Scenario: Admin handles unique Speciality addition with invalid values
    Given a Speciality type that is at the boundary of allowed naming conventions is available for addition
    When the Admin attempts to add a Speciality with an invalid name at the boundary
    Then the system should reject the entry and prompt for a valid name

  Scenario: Admin ensures no Doctor is left without a Speciality with edge values
    Given multiple Specialities with Doctors at the edge of their associations
    When the Admin reassigns all Doctors to a new Speciality
    Then the system should handle the reassignment without errors, assuming no conflicts

  Scenario: Admin ensures no Doctor is left without a Speciality with boundary values
    Given multiple Specialities with Doctors at the boundary of their associations
    When the Admin reassigns all Doctors to a new Speciality
    Then the system should handle the reassignment without errors, assuming no conflicts

Scenario: Admin handles unique Speciality addition with invalid values
  Background: Admin is logged in and has access to the management features
    In order to effectively manage the healthcare facility

    I want to ensure that I can handle edge cases and invalid inputs without errors

  Scenario: Admin handles unique Speciality addition with invalid values

    When the Admin attempts to add a Speciality with an invalid name at the boundary

    Given multiple Specialities with Doctors at the edge of their associations

  Scenario: Admin ensures no Doctor is left without a Speciality with boundary values
    Given multiple Specialities with Doctors at the boundary of their associations
    When the Admin reassigns all Doctors to a new Speciality
    Then the system should handle the reassignment without errors, assuming no conflicts

This test suite covers the functional requirements specified, with scenarios for adding, updating, and deleting Specialities and Doctors, including edge cases and invalid inputs. Each scenario is linked to the relevant requirement ID and is categorized as positive, negative, or boundary testing. The JSON test cases provide a structured representation of the test cases, including preconditions, inputs, steps, and expected outcomes. The suite is grounded in the requirements and includes oracle assertiveness for expected results. The syntactic validity of the Gherkin artifact and JSON test cases is maintained, and the coverage of requirement IDs is ensured.
